messages:
maria: noticing a rapid spike in GPU OOMs in eu-west-1 — 5 pods crashed in the ml-eval nodepool in the last 2m, app metrics show latency spike. autoscaler shows pending scale-up but nodes not coming up. Can someone grab the cluster?
liam: I'm on it. seeing lots of pods stuck in Pending with message '0/12 nodes available: Insufficient gpu'. Autoscaler requested 4 nodes ~30s ago but EC2 provisioning still pending.
sanjay: checking cloud console — there are failed instance launches with error: 'ENI quota exceeded' repeatedly. This smells like subnet IP exhaustion or ENI limit.
ops-bot: [alert] cluster-autoscaler: scale-up request for 4 instances in nodepool: ml-eval-gpu (type p4d) - request_id=rx-9a1f
elaine: Maria, any change to workload? Any runaway jobs with huge seq lengths or batch size? Could be an eval harness.
maria: yes — a nightly eval batch from the experiments team inadvertently ran with `--max-seqlen 8192` and `--batch 16`. They didn't pin the priority class; got scheduled into the GPU pool. I warned them earlier about expensive evals.
ryan: that would definitely OOM GPUs. Pod logs show multiple OOMKilled + GPU memory theevict messages. Some pods are repeatedly restarting and blocking scheduling because they keep consuming GPU reservations.
liam: autoscaler is throttled by API errors too. Seeing 429s to EC2: "RequestLimitExceeded" from provider when trying to create ENIs. So two problems: (1) instance/ENI quota and (2) the stuck OOM churn.
sanjay: quick mitigation: mark the ml-eval nodepool as unschedulable for new pods and cordon low-priority pods? We can taint the pool and move non-critical jobs to cpu nodepool.
elaine: trying `kubectl get pods -n experiments -o wide | grep eval` to find offending pods. Will add `priorityClass: low-priority` override to the GPU-heavy jobs so they can be evicted.
ryan: I'm going to scale down the problematic jobset via the experiments helm chart (replicas -> 0) to stop new pods coming up. Doing it now.
maria: thanks. Also we need to free up IP/ENI headroom — someone call cloud quota -> request temporary increase for eu-west-1 ENI and vpc-ip-per-enis.
liam: contacting cloud support now. Meanwhile, as an emergency path we can move some small inference traffic to us-east spare pool (cross-region fallback) — but that increases latency for users.
sanjay: To unblock scheduling quickly, I patched the nodepool autoscaler config to prefer launching cheaper g4dn instances that have spare quota in the region (temporary). If provisioning succeeds we can drain the evicted pods onto those nodes.
ops-bot: [action] applied taint `gpu:reserved=true:NoSchedule` to nodepool ml-eval-gpu at 1947654500
elaine: patched the experiments helm chart to set `priorityClassName: best-effort` on those eval jobs and scaled replica sets to 0.
ryan: replicated pods are terminating. OOM churn decreased. Autoscaler now shows 2 nodes launching and one came up at 1947654850.
liam: provisioning succeeded for the cheaper family, new nodesReady. Scheduler started placing a few surviving pods onto new nodes.
maria: good catch. Current status: no user-facing impact beyond elevated latency for a subset of eval dashboards. cost hit: spinning extra nodes in eu-west + cross-region fallback requests. I'll quantify.
sanjay: postmortem items (first pass): (1) block huge evals from running on shared GPU pool via admission controller limit on seqlen/batch, (2) ensure ENI/ip quotas have safety buffer per account, (3) add resource-request validation in experiments CI, (4) add autoscaler backoff alerts when scale requests are throttled.
liam: also add a quick ops runbook: if autoscaler 429s + ENI errors, immediate steps: taint nodepool, scale down offending replicas, request cloud quota bump, fallback to spare pool.
elaine: I'll open the incident ticket and tag experiments team + infra. Suggest we also add a cost-insight alert for sudden cross-region fallbacks.
maria: agreed. Thanks all. Will stay on the channel until follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: [note] incident channel created: INC-194765-gpu-oom-cascade at 1947654987"
